services.name: Sail Champlain
services.desc: July 20-July 24, 2025Ages 13-1610 participants maximum, 2 trip leaders$1,475 Tuition (Pay-What-You-Can) If you’re interested in developing sailing skills, making friends, and having a shorter overnight camping experience, this is the program for you! Sail Champlain is a 5-day sailing intensive from our base camp and nearby campsites on Lake Champlain. During the day you’ll get to practice and learn new sailing skills in our 10’ sailing dinghies and 29’ sailing whaleboats. Each evening, you’ll return to base camp, cook communal meals and camp out in tents. Our exact daily schedule will vary, depending on wind and weather conditions, so participants will need to be flexible and ready to adapt

services.name: Kayak Building
services.desc: Each summer, the Museum offers a variety of overnight summer trips and programs on Lake Champlain for teens ages 13-16 looking for an adventure and time outside connecting with nature and like-minded kids their age. Come build a kayak and set off on a multi-day expedition by kayak, canoe, rowing boat, or sail! Our teen trips and programs are designed to challenge you, get you outside, expand your comfort zone, and give you confidence, friends, and life skills that will serve you for a lifetime. All teen programs are pay-what-you-can. If you have any questions about our programs, trips, or registration, contact our expeditionary program manager, Laura Caldwell, at laurac@lcmm.org. services.name: Free Museum Tours
services.desc: Take a guided tour with a Museum expert through a sampler of exhibits to learn about the historical and archaeological heritage of Lake Champlain. Depending on the group’s interest, we will stop in exhibits which may include Fragments: Voices of the American Revolution on Lake Champlain, the Stone Schoolhouse, Hazelett Small Watercraft Center, Underwater Archaeology: Diving into the Stories of People and Canal Boats on Lake Champlain, the replica Revolutionary War gunboat Philadelphia II, and the Museum’s replica 18th Century Blacksmith
